result.summary: Routes all block script validation in ConnectBlock through CCheckQueue, eliminating the separate single-threaded execution path since the check queue natively handles execution on the caller thread when worker threads are absent. Removes the pvChecks vector output parameter and deferred check construction from CheckInputScripts, leaving it purely for inline execution. Additionally, script execution caching during TestBlockValidity is made explicit, enabling cache reuse across both single-threaded and multithreaded runs.
result.problem: CheckInputScripts previously had two distinct modes: executing script checks inline when single-threaded, or merely appending CScriptCheck objects to a vector when worker threads were available. This made the function confusing and led to a long-standing inconsistency where script execution caching during TestBlockValidity (fJustCheck=true) was silently skipped whenever worker threads were enabled.
evidence: Commit 60bc921f97 notes: "Previously, script execution cache population during TestBlockValidity (fJustCheck=true) only worked in the single-threaded case, because CheckInputScripts guarded the cache insertion with !pvChecks. In the multithreaded case, pvChecks was always set, so the cache was never populated. This inconsistency has existed since the script execution cache was introduced."
PR description notes the refactor unifies script checking logic and is motivated by follow-up work on batch validation (referencing PR #32467 and #29491).
result.scope_notes: Extracts GetScriptCacheEntry and EnsureTxData helpers from CheckInputScripts, adapts txvalidationcache_tests, and encapsulates validation cache access inside ValidationCache.
result.card: ConnectBlock is updated to route all script checking through CCheckQueue, removing a dedicated single-threaded verification path since CCheckQueue already runs checks synchronously on the calling thread when no worker threads exist. CheckInputScripts is stripped of its dual-use pvChecks output parameter and now only executes scripts inline, while script check generation for blocks is handled directly in ConnectBlock. The change also resolves a long-standing bug where block script caching during TestBlockValidity was bypassed when multithreading was enabled. The author highlights this cleanup as preparation for Schnorr batch verification work.
